body:
New net/dns.prn: parse-dns-response (pure PARENA) + build-dns-query (inline-c escape hatch, since concat's strcpy/strcat truncation would break every real query -- mostly-zero header bytes). Handles real DNS name compression. Found and worked around a real, genuine loop-variable-collision compiler bug (same class as matrix.prn's own documented one). 5/5 test assertions, make test 345/345. Commit 35edf55.

⚓ ☃
title: Real DNS query/response primitives (kanban 334534)
